description: --verbose under Jest 30.5.2 (T9.7, B21c): each file's tests listed under their describe titles with a mark (check, cross, circle for skipped, pencil for todo; skipped and todo tests after the others), a blank line after the list, and the console blocks printed as they happen, before the file's header. The same project as report-default. The kept lines are the header, the test lines, the titles, the console lines (without the `at` line) and the totals. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
